trucos: All in the «ramp races» area of the Stunt Park. Use the blue ramp with blue boxes in the middle and hit a corner without touching the boxes. After landing, drive through the mural to go back up. Barrel roll: [□] + left/right. Spin: [X] + left/right. Flip: [X] + up/down. A chime sounds for each move and everything must happen before you land.
paracaidas: Buy the paratroopers in the Toy Store ($1,500).

Hang Time: Jump off a ramp at full speed; it usually comes on its own.
Rolly Polly: Do 40 barrel rolls in a vehicle.
Cumulative: leave it for last, after the other tricks.
Dragon Rally: 12 races, bronze or better. Starts (pink beacons): by the pink bear in the Glen, at the town T junction and in the Spaceport. Each start moves to the next race when you win; stop when you are back at the first one.
Saddle the Dragon: Travel a long distance on the Dragon.
Jumpin' Jackrabits: Make a long jump with Bullseye.
Ridin' the Range: Travel a long distance on Bullseye.
Winner's Circle: Repeat the Ring Rally Race: it lasts about 40 s.
Riding the Rails: Slide a long distance on the rails.
Gone Wanderin': Travel a long distance on foot.
Parachute King: Same as the Airborn Ranger achievement.
Moving Target: Land a Paratrooper on the stagecoach.
Operation Well: Land a Paratrooper in a well.
Amateur Kicker: Grab one with [□], jump and press [□] again in the air.
Cow in the Well: Throw a cow in the well.
Farmer in the Well: Throw all the farm animals in the well.
A cow, a pig and a chicken.
Make a Wish: Throw a townsperson in the well.
Demolitions Expert: Throw barrels into groups of people; 5 or 6 are enough.
Strongman: Carry a heavy object a long distance.
Pick up a cow and walk.
Porcupine: Get hit by a cactus 10 times.
Charge a spring cactus and let it hit you back.
Junior Quick-Draw: Zap 3 townspeople with the Laser Pistol.
You get the pistol on your first run through the Spaceport.
Quick Draw Artist: Zap 10 townspeople with the Laser Pistol.
Space Deputy: Zap 5 bandits with the Laser Pistol.
Space Sheriff: Zap 10 bandits with the Laser Pistol.
Amateur Ghost Sucker: Capture 3 ghosts with the lightning rod.
Master Ghost Sucker: Capture 10 ghosts with the lightning rod.
Goes hand in hand with Master Haunter.
Master Haunter: Catch a ghost and shoot it at a townsperson. Repeat.
Master Monster Slayer: One zap of the lightning rod destroys them.
Master Sculptor: When Rex warns of an attack, take your time getting back: the town will be petrified. Use the lightning rod with [R2].
Master Re-animator: With both zombie outfit capsules, dress them at the tailor.
Pumpkin Smashing: They are around Sid's area; run over them.
Triple Flusher: The blue outhouse left of the house, past the crypt. Press its switch 3 times.
Haunted Explorer: Find all the prize capsules in Sid's Haunted House.
Spooky Sheriff: Complete all of Sid's Haunted House missions.
Rex's missions. The Abominable Snowman photo is also required.
Master Bug Collector: When the pink bear warns of an attack, take your time and use the wand with [R2]. You can also replay the big-tree mission: 4 caterpillars per run.
Master Pixie Torcher: Comes shortly after getting the Dragon.
Enchanted Sheriff: The pink bear's missions. You must create Merlin and do at least his first mission.
Master Sorcerer: Complete all of the wizard's missions.
Merlin has two: «Lost Book of Spells» and «Miss Spelled».
Woodland Explorer: Find all the prize capsules in the Glen.
Sheriff of the Future: Zurg's, plus a final one from Stinky Pete.
Space Explorer: Find all the prize capsules in the Spaceport.
Master Builder: Buy buildings in the Toy Store and place them one at a time.
Engine City: Put the engine roof on 5 buildings.
The Hot Rod Engine capsule is in the Stunt Park. Valid: barbershop, barn, hat shop, jail, muffin shop, post office and saloon.
Totally Interactive: Press every button on every building.
Barbershop, town hall, sawmill, flower shop, hat shop, newspaper, saloon, bank, tailor, blacksmith, candy shop, school, hotel, post office and muffin shop.
Green Thumb: Buy the garden ($1,000) and play the mole minigame.
Grow Your Own Gold: Grow and mine a gold vein.
Buy the goo machine ($2,500), throw green goo at a vein and mine it with [□].
Western Collector: Collect all the capsules in Woody's Roundup.
Every capsule in every area, including the candy shop.
Picto-Veteran: Complete the Sid, Glen and Spaceport Pict-O-Matic missions.
